div.div:
<chunk><location> per file
<root-aggregate> / <aggregate> with declarations and definitions
<tag index name mode layout-mark> with <label-refs> and <values> (template-engine)
<label> static or dynamic · <ordering> · <delete>
Wizard marks: <dynamic wizard="..."/>, <dynamic labelname="value"/>
<string-delimiters> · <history>

div.div:
the same skeleton; each version lists only the effective tags
a tag always has its name
labels are attributes on <value>: <value index="0" field="type">
<string> holds the rendered text
<orderings><ordering name index="position"/> per aggregate version
no Wizard marks · <history>

div.div:
fingerprint: element name, attributes except layout-mark (sorted), children, non-blank text. Two implementations (layout::fingerprint on pugixml, fingerprint on node_t) must produce the same text.
the table lives in any_transform_states_ for the whole run and is cleared and refilled by every print of XML; it matters between the print in xml2saxon and the read in xml2cpp.
